name: "Spinach & Artichoke Dip" Melts with Crunchy Mixed Veggie Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 crowns broccoli
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ orange bell peppers
3 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover; add salt and spinach. Stir until wilted, about 1 minute, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and place in a medium bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichokes; add to the bowl with the spinach along with mayo and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice cream cheese and add to the bowl with the spinach mixture; stir to combine the "dip" and set aside.
Divide bread slices between two baking sheet pans and drizzle with oil. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until toasted, about 1 minute; remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices whole grain bread
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide "dip" between toast slices and top with Parmesan. Working in batches, return to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, divide melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!
